name: FaCT-GS
definition: A framework for fast and flexible CT reconstruction that optimizes voxelization and rasterization pipelines, enabling rapid fitting of Gaussians to pre-existing volumes for warm-starting or compressed representation.
summary: FaCT-GS is a fast CT reconstruction framework that optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by removing depth-sorting overhead and coalescing data structures for efficient volumetric fitting.
